OP-HC4-SCHUR.title: Mixed or coisotropic Schur route to HC(4)
OP-HC4-SCHUR.scope: Starting from the scaled five-variable Meng--Yang family, find or exclude a genuinely nonlinear mixed source--dual or coisotropic reduction that retains a gradient collision in four Hessian variables. HC4MYA1 closes every affine four-plane restriction, HC4MYG3 closes every graph through degree three, and HC4MYG4 closes every graph y3=R(x1,x2,y1,y2) of degree at most four over every characteristic-zero field. HC4MYGJ1 strengthens this to arbitrary-degree graphs whose complete 1-jet along x1=0 has degree at most four and makes the degree-five plane determinant a uniquely solvable normal-jet equation. HC4MYGJ2 gives the exact nonzero multiplier -4*L*N^3*k*(k+1) at every normal order, so every plane trace has a unique constant-determinant formal graph; the remaining graph problem is polynomial termination and global collision, not formal normal solvability. For a degree-five graph, HC4MYG5J forces the x1-free quintic trace to kappa*x2^5, kills the y2-dependence of its quartic trace, and leaves an explicit conic in the next face. Over Q, HC4MYG5N further forces kappa nonzero and confines the full quintic top to two constant-kernel cone charts. HC4MYG5K closes the first partial_y2-kernel transverse slice when the displayed cubic and quartic trace terms are fixed and the complete degree-at-most-two lower trace T_le2(x2,y1,y2) is arbitrary. The generic y1*y2 branch gives a three-equation unit ideal, the y2^2 term is killed by a square in the forced quartic normal jet, and the exceptional x2*y2 branch ends in two coprime transverse polynomials. HC4MYG5S excludes, over every characteristic-zero field, the complete sparse trace kappa*x2^5+d*x2^3*y1+rho*x2^2*y2 with arbitrary allowed off-plane terms; an exact collision-containing graph can flatten the determinant on x1=0, but its first transverse coefficient is nonzero. The unmarked general degree-five constant-determinant graph problem remains open in broader cubic and quartic trace terms on the first chart, the other rational top chart, and possible algebraic zero-kappa branches. HCTANG3 now excludes every v2 graph through degree48 that contains both marked collision points, and every degree-at-most7 polynomial pullback with marked-point and gradient-covector matching. HC4MYGAP1 now gives an elementary all-degree obstruction to every constant affine fibre plane, and HC4MYGALL1 combines it with the reproduced Tang structural alternative to exclude the entire standard polynomial-graph collision route in every degree. The former degree49 continuation boundary is therefore superseded. Formal-series termination without a marked collision remains separate; the explicit nonrational formal example shows why local constant determinant is insufficient. This consequence uses the reproduced Tang structural theorem, Moh degree100 and the degree102 proper-power-top endpoint, not a search miss. HC4MYGT1 and HC4MYGT2 further close every polynomial graph after one triangular dual change in either order, with arbitrary base-dependent coefficients, and after any base-independent plane Keller substitution, including every constant-coefficient alternating word. Their mixed-jet and two-divisor no-plane proof is elementary; global invertibility uses the reproduced Tang theorem. Marked collisions still require the exact pulled-back gradient-covector match after nonlinear parameterization. The remaining all-degree target must use a longer base-dependent alternating word, a nonlinear base change, another graph chart, or a genuinely mixed/coisotropic mechanism outside these theorems. HC4MYR89 separately excludes collisions for every relative-linear unit-pivot correction C(x1,x2) in SL2(Q[x1,x2]) of degree at most 89. HC4MYOR1 now classifies the entire arbitrary-degree output-row orbit as the oriented generators of (x,y), including its full one-polynomial matrix stabilizer. HC4MYOR2 enlarges the sufficient matrix region to deg(C0^(-1)*C)<=99 using Moh degree100, and identifies the remaining unrestricted relative-linear problem with a singleton-zero plane Keller map. Any nonautomorphic such row must be nonproper at zero, with missing finite-normalization fibre length d-1; local ideal equality cannot supply that global completeness step. Arbitrarily high-degree stabilizer corrections can give the identical linear map and are not new search directions. HC4MYPP1 now refines the missing-length gate to a complete radial divisor budget sum(e_i*f_i)=d-1 and the general-pencil Euler identity sum_j delta_j*(deg(S_j)-mult_0(S_j))=2*g+r-1. The exceptional section proves generic irreducibility but not rationality or special-member irreducibility. HC4MYPP2 gives every generic pencil genus in the same elementary matrix orbit while preserving the zero ideal and one fixed nonconstant Jacobian polynomial; these are explicitly non-Keller controls. Thus ideal equality or row normalization cannot fill the rationality hypothesis in the published Nguyen Van Chau pencil theorem. No unrestricted properness gate is closed by these necessary budgets. HC4MYRB1 further gives the pointwise omitted-block equations Q*e=-f and ell_q=f^T*(-Q)^(-1)*f, with source canonical orders k=2e-1 on radial horizontals and k>=2e on verticals. Its exact cyclic-chain congruence excludes, in every chain length, a fully resolved block with all weights at most -2 and just one degree-one radial horizontal. HC4MYRB2 checks the scope on the retained tame-node family: odd-degree nodes need an additional radial blowup and a -1 horizontal, while even degrees have a degree-two horizontal on the minimal chain. Thus a minimal surface resolution cannot be treated as a resolved radial pencil without an ideal-principalization check. Other boundary blocks and complete global attachment remain open. HC4RSD6 characterizes affine-pivot coverage by a constant adjugate-metric rank gate, and HC4RSD7 proves that an affine scalar parent cannot inherit a marked nontrivial collision at one pivot value. HC4RSD8 through HC4RSD10 close the quadratic zero-corner branch with an identically singular reduced pencil; HC4RSD9 is the exact rank-two classification inside that chain. HC4RSD12 now closes every quadratic zero-corner scalar parent, including nonsingular exact specialized remainders. HC4RSD11 identifies every nonzero-corner cancellation exactly with a four-variable constant-Hessian pencil. For a quadratic pencil direction, rank four is impossible and HC4RSD13 makes rank three triangular; HC4RSD14 reduces rank two to HC2 or exactly the JC2 cotangent packet; HC4RSD15 identifies the two rank-one ternary charts and HC4RSD16 proves that unit border transversality freezes their rationally moving globalization. Thus every nonlinear quadratic scalar pencil reduces to HC2 or exactly the JC2 cotangent endpoint. HC4RSD17 identifies every higher-degree pencil with a polynomial nilpotent endomorphism self-adjoint for a unit Hessian metric and subject to a second Hessian-integrability system. HC4RSD18 closes generic Hessian rank one in every degree to HC2 or JC2. For cubic directions with leading Hessian rank three, HC4RSD19 excludes the unique genuinely moving kernel. HC4RSD20 synchronizes the residual constant-kernel tangent Hessians to one ruling and reduces every fixed ruling to HC2 or exact JC2. HC4RSD21 fixes every homogeneous border coefficient in every degree and every arbitrary border coefficient through degree three. HC4RSD22 closes degree four by a complete binary quartic Schur and fourth-power-top calculation. HC4RSD23 closes every degree-five border coefficient whose leading binary quintic is not a fifth power, using a simple-root square, four repeated-root Schur ideals, and immutable next-face coefficients. HC4BL5 closes the remaining pure-fifth chart, and HC4RSD24 therefore closes every degree-five border coefficient. HC4RSD25--HC4RSD28 close all non-pure sextic leading forms, and HC4RSD29--HC4RSD32 close the pure-sixth chart through its quintic flag, completed quartic, and final two-linear-form tower. Consequently every scalar degree-six leading direction is fixed. HC4RSD33 closes all non-pure septic leading forms. HC4RSD34 and HC4RSD35 open the pure-septic square; HC4RSD36, HC4RSD37, and HC4RSD38 then close every curved pure-septic chart: all six nonzero-k packets die, and the corrected zero-k coupled Wronskian has the complete ordered two-linear-form solution F=L*E^3,G=L*E^2,D=L*E, whose five projective charts also die. HC4RSD39 closes every curved shifted-quintic correction on the passive-affine boundary and reduces the last pure-septic two-linear-form tower to eight explicit degree-fifteen quartic direction packets. HC4RSD40 gives them a common quartic-polar rank-one split: the square-Hessian resonance dies by immutable lower coefficients and the only nonempty zero strata are fixed cylinders. HC4MR1 consolidates the continuation through HC4RSD41--80. HC4MRA1 found a determinant-transport gap in the old final regular J4 argument and closes the positive motion sign by differentiated identities. HC4MRA2 repairs the remaining negative sign by restricting the polynomial endomorphism to an affine middle-plane leaf and applying the ODE 2*n*n_second-3*n_prime^2=0, which has only constant polynomial solutions. The full auxiliary relative-pencil reduction to HC2/JC2 is thus restored by a global polynomial argument, without the unsupported d(pq)=0 premise. Mechanisms outside that closed auxiliary branch include nonconstant mixed source--dual 2-by-2 Schur pivots, higher nonlinear canonical transformations, and reductions creating a different collision. SDX2 and HC4MCP1 through HC4MCP10 close the declared affine-block and short-word boxes; HC4MCP10 removes the coefficient and constant-direction bounds for every scalar and two-plane unit block on the nonlinear HC4MCP6 resonance family. Polynomially moving pivots on that family remain open. This inherited-collision route is distinct from OP-HC4-D5: HC4TC1 closes the coordinate q2+h3+h4+h6 chart, while HC4CD5 identifies the parallel quintic--sextic Hessian-metric divisibility frontier.

forbidden_attack_classes.attack: Affine Meng--Yang four-plane descent
forbidden_attack_classes.reason: Every affine normal chart is either Hessian-degenerate or has an unavoidable nonconstant determinant coefficient.

forbidden_attack_classes.attack: Degree-at-most-three single-graph descent
forbidden_attack_classes.reason: Two exact line restrictions give a triangular coefficient contradiction before collision equations are imposed.

forbidden_attack_classes.attack: Degree-at-most-four single-graph descent
forbidden_attack_classes.reason: The full two-slope jet ends in two coprime quadratic equations for the same cubic graph coefficient, so no characteristic-zero quartic graph survives.

forbidden_attack_classes.attack: A quartic graph 1-jet plus an arbitrary x1-squared tail
forbidden_attack_classes.reason: The plane determinant depends only on the graph trace and first normal jet, so every x1-squared tail is invisible to the already contradictory quartic plane calculation.

forbidden_attack_classes.attack: Rational quintic graph tops outside the two constant-kernel cone charts
forbidden_attack_classes.reason: The leading plane faces and the four-variable zero-Hessian cone theorem force a nonzero vertical quintic trace and one of two constant-kernel normal forms.

forbidden_attack_classes.attack: The partial_y2-kernel quintic trace with the complete degree-at-most-two lower trace
forbidden_attack_classes.reason: For arbitrary T_le2(x2,y1,y2), the generic branch gives a repair-invariant unit ideal, the y2^2 coefficient is killed by a quartic-normal square, and the exceptional x2*y2 branch has two transverse polynomials with nonzero resultant; the denominator chart is separately excluded.

forbidden_attack_classes.attack: The sparse v2 quintic trace kappa*x2^5+d*x2^3*y1+rho*x2^2*y2
forbidden_attack_classes.reason: Exact plane elimination and immutable first-transverse coefficients give a characteristic-zero contradiction even with arbitrary x1-linear and x1-squared allowed terms.

forbidden_attack_classes.attack: Scalar reverse Schur descent through a cone pencil
forbidden_attack_classes.reason: Generic corank one and the bordered-unit factorization force a common constant kernel direction, reducing every collision fiber to HC3.

forbidden_attack_classes.attack: Parameter-independent affine moving-kernel scalar pencils
forbidden_attack_classes.reason: Piola leaves the unique nonconstant orbit v=(z,1,0,0); exact integration and the bordered unit force a normal form whose descendants have triangular polynomial inverses.

forbidden_attack_classes.attack: Parameter-moving affine-kernel scalar pencils
forbidden_attack_classes.reason: Adjugate degree and Piola reduce the primitive kernel to rank-one compression pencils; every moving chart collapses to a fixed line, is inconsistent, or has reduced Hessian rank at most two.

forbidden_attack_classes.attack: Fixed transverse polynomial shear kernels
forbidden_attack_classes.reason: For v=(P(z,w),1,0,0), exact integration and the bordered unit force the transverse common composite onto one linear form and yield a triangular polynomial inverse.

forbidden_attack_classes.attack: Fixed primitive two-component kernels in a constant support plane
forbidden_attack_classes.reason: For v=(P,Q,0,0) with (P,Q)=1, Piola first eliminates active-variable dependence. The bordered unit then produces a constant-determinant polynomial frame; polynomial degree forces (P,Q) onto an affine line, reducing the family to HC4RSD4.

forbidden_attack_classes.attack: Affine scalar descent preserving a marked collision
forbidden_attack_classes.reason: For every zero-corner affine scalar parent with constant nonzero bordered Hessian determinant, the inverse-Hessian metric numerator is the constant Hessian determinant of every affine pivot fiber. HC3 makes the tangential gradient injective on that fiber, while equal parent gradients at a common pivot value force the two points onto the same fiber. This covers singular reductions and the nonsingular exact-remainder branch.

forbidden_attack_classes.attack: Rank-at-least-three quadratic scalar pivots through a singular Hessian pencil
forbidden_attack_classes.reason: Rank four contradicts pencil singularity through its leading determinant coefficient. In rank three, the null-direction block and the constant bordered determinant force a polynomial square to equal a nonzero constant times a cubic polynomial in the pencil parameter.

forbidden_attack_classes.attack: Rank-two quadratic scalar pivots through a singular Hessian pencil
forbidden_attack_classes.reason: The passive-rank-zero stratum reduces to the fixed-support HC4RSD5 theorem. On passive rank one, the remaining determinant faces integrate to A=x*y+w and B=x*z+rho*(y+h(x)*A)^2/2+beta(x)*y+gamma(x)*A+delta(x), whose every Schur descendant has a triangular polynomial gradient inverse.

forbidden_attack_classes.attack: Rank-one quadratic scalar pivots through a singular Hessian pencil
forbidden_attack_classes.reason: After A=x^2/2+w, the passive three-by-three Hessian has rank one. Its polynomial-Hessian normal form and the exact bordered unit frame force B=x*z+rho*(y+h(x)*w)^2/2+alpha(x)*y+gamma(x)*w+delta(x), whose every Schur descendant has a triangular polynomial gradient inverse.

forbidden_attack_classes.attack: Treating nonzero-corner scalar cancellation as an independent five-variable mechanism
forbidden_attack_classes.reason: Completing the square gives an exact equivalence with a four-variable constant-Hessian pencil, including a bijection of marked gradient collisions.

forbidden_attack_classes.attack: Quadratic zero-corner scalar pivots with an arbitrary reduced pencil
forbidden_attack_classes.reason: The bordered unit supplies a constant direction along which the quadratic pivot has nonzero constant derivative. Graph coordinates then factor the parent determinant into ternary Hessian determinants, and HC3 excludes every collision fiber.

forbidden_attack_classes.attack: Rank-three quadratic nonzero-corner constant-Hessian pencils
forbidden_attack_classes.reason: The determinant faces and ternary eikonal integrability force a triangular normal form with an explicit polynomial gradient inverse; rank four is already impossible from the leading face.

forbidden_attack_classes.attack: Rank-two quadratic constant-Hessian pencils outside the JC2 cotangent packet
forbidden_attack_classes.reason: The passive-rank-one stratum reduces to HC2, while passive rank zero is exactly the cotangent lift of a plane Keller map.

forbidden_attack_classes.attack: Rank-one quadratic pencils outside the JC2 cotangent packet
forbidden_attack_classes.reason: The constant-kernel chart reduces to HC2 and the exceptional chart is exactly a JC2 cotangent lift. Unit border transversality freezes both rationally x-moving globalizations.

forbidden_attack_classes.attack: Arbitrary-degree scalar pencil directions of generic Hessian rank one outside the JC2 cotangent packet
forbidden_attack_classes.reason: The rank-one polynomial-Hessian normal form is univariate in a constant linear coordinate. Its sole pencil face is the same singular passive ternary Hessian used in the quadratic proof, and unit transversality freezes both rational charts without a degree bound.

forbidden_attack_classes.attack: Genuinely moving cubic scalar directions whose leading Hessian has rank three
forbidden_attack_classes.reason: The unique moving normal form integrates the leading null face in a polynomial invariant coordinate. The next face kills both transverse derivatives, and the last two faces force units with incompatible active derivatives.

forbidden_attack_classes.attack: Fixed-ruling constant-kernel cubic scalar packets outside the JC2 cotangent endpoint
forbidden_attack_classes.reason: The full tangent binary pencil synchronizes Hess(a) and Hess(c) to one ruling. A constant ruling makes c a cylinder; its straight-level chart is triangular over HC2 and its curved chart is exactly a plane Keller cotangent lift.

forbidden_attack_classes.attack: Homogeneous border coefficients or arbitrary border coefficients of degree at most four in the constant-kernel cubic packet
forbidden_attack_classes.reason: The universal-field identity and homogeneous Hesse theorem fix every homogeneous ruling. The complete cubic and quartic root-chart calculations force a cylinder in every nonhomogeneous degree-at-most-four chart, including the apparent double--double quartic cancellation.

forbidden_attack_classes.attack: Relative-linear unit-pivot corrections of degree at most 89
forbidden_attack_classes.reason: Constant Hessian reduces to a plane Keller map of degree at most 100, hence the descended gradient is a polynomial automorphism and has no collision.

forbidden_attack_classes.attack: Marked-collision v2 Meng--Yang graphs through degree48, or polynomial pullbacks through degree7 with the stated collision jet match
forbidden_attack_classes.reason: The degree-preserving structural theorem and Moh degree100 imply HC4 through potential degree101 and at degree102 with a proper-power top. Graph degree48 has precisely such a square top, while degree7 general pullbacks have degree at most98. Their transferred marked collision contradicts invertibility.

forbidden_attack_classes.attack: Any-degree polynomial graph r=R(x,y,p,q) in the standard Meng--Yang graph coordinates as a gradient-counterexample route
forbidden_attack_classes.reason: The fixed x=0 slice and polynomial q-degree exclude every constant affine fibre plane. The reproduced Tang structural alternative then makes every unit-Hessian graph gradient invertible. Nonlinear reparameterizations and other reduction mechanisms require a distinct argument.

forbidden_attack_classes.attack: One arbitrary-degree triangular dual change in either order, or a base-independent plane Keller substitution, followed by a polynomial graph as a gradient-counterexample route
forbidden_attack_classes.reason: The universal mixed-jet, polynomial-degree and two-divisor arguments exclude a cotangent plane in all three classes. The reproduced Tang structural theorem forces every unit-Hessian gradient in those classes to be invertible. Arbitrary base-dependent alternating words are not obtained by composing these conclusions.

forbidden_attack_classes.attack: Treating stabilizer degree growth or a singleton affine zero fibre as evidence of a new relative-linear counterexample
forbidden_attack_classes.reason: The complete stabilizer leaves the output map and potential unchanged in every degree. The singleton-zero row orbit still needs a properness/completeness theorem at zero; an actual source-A3 Keller control has a singleton fibre while two other normalization sheets escape. The normalized degree99 gate is sufficient, not a new plane frontier.

forbidden_attack_classes.attack: Inferring rationality of a Keller pencil from oriented ideal equality or determinant-one row normalization alone
forbidden_attack_classes.reason: The elementary control H_g stays in the same oriented row orbit and has the same full nonconstant Jacobian for every genus g>=0. It is not Keller, so further restrictions from a constant Jacobian remain a legitimate open direction. The source section proves only generic geometric irreducibility; published all-member rationality and irreducibility hypotheses must still be checked.

forbidden_attack_classes.attack: A fully resolved omitted radial block that is a chain of weights at most -2 with exactly one horizontal component of degree1
forbidden_attack_classes.reason: The cyclic intersection-lattice congruence forces that sole horizontal degree to be divisible by Delta/gcd(Delta,K_prefix), at least2 for every chain length. The radial ideal must already be invertible on the stated graph; an extra -1 horizontal from principalizing a basepoint is outside this exclusion.

OP-PLANE.title: Plane-Jacobian universal boundary and degree frontier
OP-PLANE.scope: UCBS1 proves degree-independent purity and H_Z^0 vanishing for the logarithmic cotangent cokernel, while LCDS1 places conductor mismatches in H_Z^1. PF2LNP1, PF2CLP1, PF2UCE1, LCBBC1, LCCT1, LKGD1, LTKT1, and PF2OTT1 classify the known F2 logarithmic packets and give exact cyclic root contribution 27 with zero outgoing-tail correction. PF2APF1 proves that purity requires at least one additional affine-branch boundary component, raising the squarefree/double source floors to 28/49. It bounds the geometric degrees by 6<=d<=9375 and 12<=d<=9375 and every ramified row by 2<=e<=d-1 and f<=floor((d-1)/e), but a coarse purity signature exists at every remaining d. PF2ATC1 reduces the unknown target curve to 24 normalization charts (deg p,deg q)=(3k,5k), 1<=k<=24, with projective degree 5k<=120, top implicit form P^(5k), an affine singularity, and a nonunit divided-difference collision/critical ideal. PF2K1C1 solves the first chart's collision geometry by one explicit quartic and proves that its generic target is a rational quintic with four ordinary affine nodes and a delta-2 (2,5) infinity cusp. PF2K1I1 gives its exact twelve-support implicit quintic and factors the pulled-back target gradient as the degree-eight nodal conductor times (q',-p'). PF2K1PB1 restores that quintic to fixed target coordinates, computes its carrier residue and finite eight-jet contact interface, and proves that every Keller pullback is reduced with affine singular/conductor scheme equal to the etale base change of the target singularities. PF2K1JF1 proves the target quintic is irreducible in every k=1 specialization, replaces seven normalized carrier conditions by four parameter-recovery equations plus three exact weighted compatibility equations, and separates the false C^3/s^2 origin factors from the invariant terminal leading fiber. PCJDP1 proves that the primitive (3,5) seven-jet packet ends exactly at raw-jet saturation and gives an explicit cusp-plus-three-node nonimmersion chart, but does not identify its jet ramification with a logarithmic point defect. PF2K1CC1 proves that every k=1 degeneration still has affine delta 4 and the same exact degree-eight conductor divisor, with affine Keller-pullback normalization defect at most 4*(d-1); only the finite singular-fiber counts and boundary distribution remain. PF2K1TN1 proves that every fs tame Kummer toroidal packet over a resolved target node, including the split smooth model and the collided cyclic z^e=x*y model with its full exceptional chain, is log-etale and has zero logarithmic cokernel and localized ch2. Hence target conductor length cannot be charged automatically. Its general SNC formula also proves that full-rank exponent data force zero cokernel and that a rank-one packet can have singular determinant support only after two explicit logarithmic-unit first jets vanish; failure of a toroidal chart is necessary but not sufficient for a point defect. PAER1 proves that every affine reduced-curve singularity, including the cusp-plus-three-node stratum, pulls through a Keller map by strict etale base change on embedded resolutions. Its ordinary conductor and carrier-parameter rank drop are not finite pieces of the relative logarithmic module; only compactification-boundary attachments remain. Under LUAF1's minimal transverse unibranch SNC hypotheses such a boundary point has local correction q_p*m_C and a complete residue-degree-f fiber has total correction m_C*f; q_p is distinct from the transverse divisorial index e, and those hypotheses still have to be extracted from the source. LCAD1 gives the general isolated-Fitting lower ledger m_C*f-h+c; for an ordinary cusp it ranges from f on smooth folds to 2*f on node-saturated packets. PF2PPA1 places every target puncture on the extracted (5,2) divisor with contact k. Although a formal direct terminal comparison would force lambda=125/729 and e=3, the terminal neighborhood is already resolved and every divisor extracted above it maps to one point; it supplies no affine-row slot. LCHB1 proves the degree-independent global logarithmic ch2 and boundary-blowup identities and computes provisional F2 budgets (7*d-8)/2 and (7*d-13)/2 on the current common partial model. After the exact root class 27 the degree-floor virtual residuals are -10 and 17/2. PF2K1L1 computes the generic k=1 affine divisorial contribution as e*f*(b-7)-e^2*n/2 and gives the all-signature conditional squarefree/double point formulas (e^2*n-2*e*f*(b-7)-20-s_X)/2 and (e^2*n-2*e*f*(b-7)+17-s_X)/2 with exact parity gates. On the generic cusp face, the incidence-sensitive cusp ledger tightens these effectivity bounds without changing parity. PF2K1M1 proves complement group Z on every immersed distinct-image k=1 collision partition and on the generic A_2+3*A_1 and 2*A_2+2*A_1 cusp strata. Their positive affine-sheet remainder prevents one component meridian from acting transitively, so each of these seven strata requires a second ramified affine target component and has conditional source floors 29/50; its Chern compiler must contain two affine divisorial packets. The first topological escape is E_6+A_1, whose noncyclic group has an exact transitive degree-six fixed-sheet action, so its multiplicity-three boundary packet must be combined with the global Chern budget. PF2D6E1 excludes the normal even terminal exponents r=6,8,10. PF2D6O1 proves the sharp polynomial degree-(6,10) odd gap bound 21 and excludes normal r=9; normal odd r=5,7 and nonnormal conductor slices remain. The primary global target is therefore to supply the complete fixed-coordinate F2 Laurent pair and factor its explicit quintic only at the unresolved source boundary in order to locate the required affine divisors, determine their (e,f,E^2) data, and extract the local exponent matrices and logarithmic unit derivatives. Finite affine fiber counts remain useful boundary-escape data but are not logarithmic point corrections. Only rank-one packets satisfying both first-jet equations require higher expansion; the complement/conductor calculation must still cover severe k=1 image mergers, the E_8 endpoint, and k=2..24 if k=1 is not forced. Independently, PJ43A1, PJ72Q1, RSE3, and PJ72108D1 close the audited (72,108)/(108,72) row and leave the conditional larger-coordinate frontier at 125. PF2KO1, PF2TR1, PF2GC1, PF2GA1, PF2CW1, PCW1, PF2CS1, and PF2NF1 classify substantial necessary data on the first F2 row but do not supply that global branch-curve factorization, global degree, meridian completion, complete Chern filtration, or lower-Laurent realization. Degree-specific calculations remain regression fixtures for the universal compiler; they do not exclude (75,125), improve the coordinate-degree frontier 125, or prove JC(2).

forbidden_attack_classes.attack: Charging target conductor or normalization length directly as a degree-zero logarithmic boundary-point defect
forbidden_attack_classes.reason: Purity kills zero-dimensional H0 in the relative logarithmic cokernel, while normalization mismatch lives in H1 and has no nonzero O-linear lift back to H0.

forbidden_attack_classes.attack: Using resolved affine cusp, node, or carrier-jet singularities as the missing logarithmic source correction
forbidden_attack_classes.reason: Embedded resolution commutes with the etale Keller pullback and is strict log-etale; only unresolved compactification-boundary attachments can contribute.

forbidden_attack_classes.attack: Assigning a positive logarithmic correction to a tame full-rank toroidal packet
forbidden_attack_classes.reason: The exact monomial chart calculation gives zero logarithmic cokernel and localized second Chern term; rank-one packets survive only after two explicit unit-jet equations vanish.

forbidden_attack_classes.attack: Promoting closure of the audited (72,108) Laurent systems to the general plane degree reduction or JC(2)
forbidden_attack_classes.reason: The exact determinantal certificate closes only the two named systems; larger coordinate degrees and the global F2 boundary carrier remain open.
